name: AD828
type: Bipolar VFB dual video op-amp, optimised for G ≥ +2
tagline: ADI's 130 MHz, 450 V/µs dual video op-amp; Chinese sound-card and car-audio modders rate it above the AD827.

lineage.note: Sole source; no second sources known. Relation to AD826/AD827/AD847 dies is unconfirmed.

part_numbers.note: Family part number; ADI product page is live.
Leaded 8-lead PDIP. Reportedly in PDN 10_0081 Rev. B; not confirmed in its visible pages.
RoHS 8-lead PDIP; listed as production; in PCN 26_0029 (Camas fab).
Leaded 8-lead SOIC and reels; distributors list obsolete. Replaced by AD828ARZ.
RoHS 8-lead SOIC and reels; production per RadioLocman and Utmel.

key_specs.value: 130 MHz −3 dB bandwidth; 0.1 dB flat to 40 MHz
+5 V single, or ±5 V to ±15 V dual

reputation.summary: Praise comes from Chinese DIY sources. A CSDN ranking of 22 op-amps credits the AD828AN with 'jump, grandeur, extension' but a slightly rough midrange, above the AD827. Elecfans calls the AD828AR neutral, with strong bass dynamics and clear, extended highs. Autohome car-audio modders use it; one Bilibili review was negative. No Western or measurement-based consensus.
typical_uses: Vendor intent: video line and cable drivers, G ≥ +2
caveats: Optimised for G ≥ +2; may ring or oscillate as a unity-gain buffer. Check stability and decoupling.
Praise is subjective, mostly from Chinese forums and marketing-style pages; one Bilibili review was negative.
PDIP AD828AN appears discontinued; marketplace DIP parts may be new-old stock or remarked.

counterfeit_notes: No AD828-specific counterfeit reports. The PDIP AD828AN is in ADI PDN 10_0081 Rev. B, so DIP-8 parts and cheap AD828 boards may be new-old stock, pulls or remarks. Buy SOIC AD828ARZ from authorised distributors.

silicon_changes.summary: PCN 26_0029, 'Qualification of Wafer Fabrication Site Analog Devices, Inc. Camas WA for CB Products', qualifies ADI's Camas fab for complementary-bipolar parts. Published 27 April 2026, effective 30 July 2026; AD828 codes are listed.
silicon_changes.identification: No marking change described; parts with date codes after July 2026 may come from Camas.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None expected; datasheet limits unchanged. Listening claims for old vs new stock would be anecdotal.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same datasheet, package and pinout.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN title, dates and AD828 listing seen in search snippets; full parts list not read.

open_questions: Rev. B print date and Rev. B→C change list; do Rev. 0/A copies survive?
Is AD828AN listed in PDN 10_0081 Rev. B, and when was it discontinued?
Will Camas-fab AD828 parts (PCN 26_0029) differ measurably from earlier stock?
Missing specs: settling, swing into 150 Ω, noise at 1 kHz; is 15 mA max or typ?
Is the AD828 unity-gain stable? ADI only says it targets gains of +2 or more.

claims_confirmed: ADI's 'Dual, Low Power Video Op Amp': low-cost dual optimised for G ≥ +2 and cable driving (https://www.analog.com/en/products/ad828.html).
130 MHz at G = +2, 450 V/µs, 0.1 dB to 40 MHz, 0.01%/0.05° diff gain/phase, 15 mA supply, 50 mA min output (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD828.pdf).
Current ADI datasheet is Rev. C (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ad828.pdf).
AD828ARZ is listed as in production (https://octopart.com/ad828arz-analog+devices-411908).
AD828AN reportedly appears in ADI PDN 10_0081 Rev. B (https://www.analog.com/media/en/pcn/ADI_PDN_10_0081_Rev_B_Form.pdf).

Rev. C copy carries © Analog Devices 2002; +5 V single or ±5 V to ±15 V supplies (https://www.radiolocman.com/datasheet/pdf.html?di=121449, https://wcm-cce.cldnet.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD828.pdf).

Rev. B copies exist on mirrors, 12 pages; ordering codes AD828AN (PDIP), AD828AR, -REEL, -REEL7 (SOIC), −40 to +85 °C (https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/48431/AD/AD828.html, https://dtsheet.com/doc/98149/ad-ad828ar).
Input voltage noise 10 nV/√Hz at 10 kHz, ±5 V and ±15 V; offset 2 mV max (https://www.cieri.net/Documenti/Data%20Sheets/Operational%20Amplifiers/AD828%20(Analog%20Devices).pdf).
AD828AR and AD828AR-REEL listed obsolete by distributors (https://www.aeri.com/pn/analog-devices-inc/AD828AR, https://www.fpgacenter.com/product/analog-devices/AD828AR).

AD828ANZ, AD828ARZ, AD828ARZ-REEL7 listed in production and named in ADI PCN 26_0029 (https://www.radiolocman.com/datasheet/data.html?di=351347, https://www.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_26_0029_Rev_-_Form.pdf).
PCN 26_0029 qualifies ADI's Camas WA wafer fab for complementary-bipolar products; published 2026-04-27, effective 2026-07-30 (https://www.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_26_0029_Rev_-_Form.pdf).
